title: Mont Habitant
specs: Alpine touring trail patrolled and open during resort hours
Tennis attire and shoes for clay courts mandatory
Children 12 and under must be accompanied by someone 16 or older at beach
Open water swimming reserved for 18 and over, must have own buoy and be able to swim 300m
Must be accompanied by adult to rent equipment if 15 or under; 16+ must show ID
Alpine touring requires valid access ticket
Minimum 15 persons per group for group ski tickets and school groups
includes: Ski ticket included with 10 weekend and holiday camps
Helmet included with complete equipment rental
gap: Exact address and city not stated
blurb: Guests can ski or snowboard on marked trails, take lessons for all ages and levels, enjoy alpine touring on designated trails, and use tennis and beach facilities including watercraft rentals. The site includes supervised swimming zones and enforces safety and conduct rules. Season passes and day tickets are available for various activities.
extraNote: Season passes non-refundable after season start; $40 admin fee plus taxes for refunds before season · Lessons must be rescheduled before 4pm day before or lesson is lost; no refunds · Memberships non-reimbursable and non-transferable
